title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-agenda-prep-2026-12-01-evan.json
content:
Purpose: personal prep for weekly cross-team sync (serving runtime / infra / console).
Date: 2026-12-01 meeting (weekly).
Attendees expected: Priya, Jorge, Lina, Rahul, Evan, on-call rotator.

Top goals for this week:
- Quick health check: any P1s or regressions since last sync?
- Decide on canary rollout windows for quantization-2.1 kernels.
- Align on SLO alert tuning after KV cache change (rollout impact).
- Action item review from last week and assign owners.
- Quick ops items for console: add token-cost breakdown to per-route dashboard.

Agenda (30 min):
1) 5m - Quick round: 1-line status (green/yellow/red) from each area
   - Serving runtime: latency & regressions
   - Infra: capacity & autoscale incidents
   - Console: dashboards & rollout config UI

2) 8m - KV cache change follow-up (owner: Priya)
   - Summary: rolled prefix caching for small seqs last Tue; noticed tail latency bump for 99th on nv4x2 after 6h window.
   - Key question: is bump due to new eviction heuristic? Evidence: increased mem pressure + GC spikes on node A cluster-us-east-1b.
   - Desired outcome: agree on mitigation (rollback vs patch).

3) 7m - Canary for quantization-2.1 kernel (owner: Jorge)
   - Plan: 10% traffic for 24h to dedicated pool, monitor output diffs, latency p50/p99, error rates.
   - Risk: fallback path currently noisy; need automatic rollback policy if ASR > 0.5%
   - Ask: confirm windows and alert thresholds.

4) 6m - Console dashboard + billing breakdown (owner: Lina)
   - Request: add token-level cost column to per-route view; show delta vs baseline.
   - Quick UX ask: make the cost column sortable and exportable for finance.

5) 4m - Action items & next steps
   - Quick assign and close loop.

Personal prep notes / talking points:
- For KV cache: collect GC logs from node A and B (Priya asked to grab logs). If GC spikes match timeline of latency bump, propose narrower eviction window instead of full rollback.
- For quantization canary: ensure evicted cache warming isn't confounding perf numbers (if we move traffic to dedicated pool, pre-warm KV cache with synthetic prefixes).
- Console: provide mock CSV export layout for Lina so she can wire the backend fields.

Unresolved questions (to raise in sync):
- Did infra change the instance churn policy last week? (I saw a scaling event but not sure if related to the blue-green test).
- Who will own the canary rollback automation? (SRE or serving runtime?)

Action items (tracker - my personal view; will publish to shared board after meeting):
- [ACTION] Priya: Collect GC + memory profiles for node A/B and correlate with KV cache rollout time. Due: 2026-12-03.
- [ACTION] Jorge: Stand up 10% canary for quantization-2.1, pre-warm KV cache, publish perf delta metrics dashboard. Due: 2026-12-02.
- [ACTION] Lina: Prototype per-route cost column UI + sample CSV export schema; share with finance and me. Due: 2026-12-04.
- [ACTION] Rahul: Draft rollback automation playbook (criteria for automated rollback on quality/latency regressions). Due: 2026-12-07.
- [ACTION] Evan (me): Update shared Confluence page with this week's agenda + paste action items to JIRA board. Due: 2026-12-01 (post-meeting).

Notes to self (scratchpad):
- Bring up: we should consider a short annotation on console dashboards indicating rollout state (canary %, active flag). Small UX win and reduces context switching.
- Keep an eye on cost delta after quantization; sometimes latency improvements increase token usage due to different decoding behavior. Add unit to monitor.
- Reminder: follow up with solutions-eng on customer X who reported tail latency last week (ticket JIRA-1188).

Prep checklist (done / todo):
- [x] Draft agenda (this doc)
- [x] Ping attendees in Slack #eng-serving-runtime
- [ ] Attach GC logs (Priya)
- [ ] Canary run started (Jorge)
- [ ] Console proto uploaded (Lina)

Post-meeting follow-up template (copy into notes):
- Summary: one-line per area (runtime / infra / console)
- Action items assigned (owner + due date)
- Decisions: rollout windows, rollback thresholds, immediate mitigations
- Open issues for next week: list and owner

Quick links I may paste during meeting:
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-serve-runtime-slo
- JIRA board: JIRA-1234 (kv-cache-rollout)
- GH PR for quantization kernels: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/891

Draft message to paste in channel after meeting:
"Notes from today’s cross-team sync: summary + action items (listed). Priya will post GC logs to the ticket; Jorge is kicking off the quantization canary; Lina to upload console prototype. Please ack assigned actions in JIRA. Evan to file short post-meeting summary."
